strategies.name: Socket-filter trigger → on-host raw-socket activity → reverse connection (T1205.002)

analytics.name: Analytic 0462
analytics.guidance: Adversary installs/uses packet-capture or raw-socket capability (WinPcap/Npcap, wpcap/packet DLLs or raw socket attach) and sets a filter. A crafted inbound packet is observed; within a short window the host process that loaded capture libraries initiates an outbound connection (e.g., reverse shell) to the packet origin.

tuning.description: Seconds to correlate inbound trigger → process library load/driver start → outbound connect (default 120s).
DLL/driver names to match (wpcap.dll, packet.dll, npcap.sys, npf.sys) – extend for EDR drivers in your fleet.
Signed/expected processes allowed to install/start Npcap (software distribution tools).
Likely egress ports to watch after trigger (4444, 53, 80/443, 8080, high ephemeral).

log_sources.name: NSM:Flow
log_sources.channel: Single, low-volume inbound packet (REJ/S0/OTH or uncommon dport/protocol) from src_ip followed by outbound SF connection to src_ip.

analytics.name: Analytic 0463
analytics.guidance: Process creates a raw/packet socket and attaches a (e)BPF filter (setsockopt SO_ATTACH_FILTER/ATTACH_BPF or bpf(BPF_PROG_LOAD)). Immediately after a matching inbound packet, the same process binds/connects outward to a remote host (reverse shell or beacon).

tuning.description: Flag raw-socket activity outside privileged daemons (root-only by default).
If using packet content (Zeek), treat high-entropy single-packet triggers as suspicious.
System services allowed to open AF_PACKET (dhclient, keepalived, LLDP, monitoring agents).

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: socket(AF_PACKET|AF_INET, SOCK_RAW, *), setsockopt(… SO_ATTACH_FILTER|SO_ATTACH_BPF …), bpf(cmd=BPF_PROG_LOAD), open/openat path="/dev/bpf*" (BSD/macOS-like) or setcap cap_net_raw.

log_sources.name: linux:osquery
log_sources.channel: family=AF_PACKET or protocol raw; process name not in allowlist.

log_sources.name: NSM:Flow
log_sources.channel: Rare inbound packet characteristics (ICMP/UDP/TCP to uncommon port) from src_ip followed ≤TimeWindow by outbound SF from same host to src_ip.

analytics.name: Analytic 0464
analytics.guidance: Process opens /dev/bpf* (libpcap) or loads NetworkExtension filter, then after a crafted inbound packet the same process initiates an outbound connection to the trigger origin.

tuning.description: Alternate BPF device paths if customized (default /dev/bpf*).
Relax thresholds on known developer tooling hosts (Xcode, instrumenting tools).

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: First outbound connection from the same PID/user shortly after an inbound trigger.

log_sources.name: NSM:Flow
log_sources.channel: Inbound one-off packet to uncommon port → outbound SF to same src_ip within TimeWindow.
